title: The unknown-reads contract lint runs on Linux only
why: Retrospective CI audit 15:53 CST Nov 12: lint/check_unknown_reads_contract.py runs on Linux, macOS and Windows (checks.yml:551, :1183, :1896), against decision test-strategy-reset line 20 ("pure lints run on ubuntu only"). Lane question 03:23 CST Nov 14 (lane of #3005, head 06ccf55df, sent direct; unchecked by triage): the coordinator's 03:20 note said this step cuts macOS work; #3005 removes only the Windows run of the unknown-reads lint, and the macOS run (checks-macos, checks.yml l.1344 on main 4db2a9cf3) stays for step ci-mac-once-per-batch. This step's own text says the same. Answer by triage: keep #3005 Windows-only (the lane's own option a, no widening, no departure from main), so no owner question. The lane waits on runner 10 for the lane lint. Correction 03:24 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:24): my 03:25 answer "(a) Windows-only" is overruled by the coordinator, an undoable pick of its own; it says its own 03:21 message (the PR "cuts one macOS step") was said without reading the diff, and its first correction swung back without reading it either. The lane reads the head: both runs dropped.
note: Drop both the Windows run and the macOS run of the lint, so it runs on Linux only (coordinator pick 03:24 CST Nov 14, overruling triage's earlier Windows-only answer; the macOS drop is also listed in ci-mac-once-per-batch, whose lane is archived, so no clash). Lane head 013e6d573 does both, with a new test red on 06ccf55df and green on the head (the lane's read, unchecked by triage). Express under R55 (CI fixes).
